controls.finding: Mem0 and knowledge facts have no mandatory stable data-subject identifier; available removal is keyword-substring based.
Retrieval consults hot, cold, and fact collections, but purge scans only hot documents and facts.
No mandatory evidence-class retention policy, expiry timestamp, or lawful-basis field was found in Mem0 storage.
Mem0 retrieval scans the shared knowledge fact cache and filters by source prefix and lexical relevance, not tenant ownership.
All committed Fly app configurations pin primary_region to London, but live machine and replica placement was not verified during this audit.
No verified procedure demonstrates propagation of a subject erasure into snapshots, backups, exports, and restored replicas.
No per-subject or per-record encryption-key lifecycle was found; crypto-shredding is therefore unavailable.

phase_2_gate: Do not expand continuous personal-data ingestion until subject-keyed erasure, all-collection deletion, retention metadata, backup handling, and residency verification have passing evidence.
